title: Vacuous $rose Assertion — Signal Never Rises
bug_signature: UVM_WARNING: [VACUOUS] $rose(gnt) never true; assertion vacuously passed
rtl:
// SVA: check grant followed by active
assert property (@(posedge clk) $rose(gnt) |-> ##1 active);  // gnt never rises in test
expected_root_cause: The SVA property checks $rose(gnt) as its antecedent, but gnt is driven to 0 throughout the entire test; $rose(gnt) is never true, so the property passes vacuously without exercising any part of the actual grant logic.
fix_replacement:
assert property (@(posedge clk) disable iff (!rst_n) $rose(gnt) |-> ##1 active);
cover  property (@(posedge clk) $rose(gnt));  // Force antecedent to fire
description: An assertion checks `$rose(gnt) |-> ##1 active` but gnt is driven to 0 all test, so $rose(gnt) is never true; the property passes vacuously with no real coverage.
failure_log: UVM_WARNING: [VACUOUS] $rose(gnt) never true; assertion vacuously passed
success_log: cover property hit: $rose(gnt) triggered. Assertion evaluated and passed meaningfully.
